openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead found. All leads place the institution in Odesa (not occupied territory). No post-2020 news result about the institution's operation, suspension or relocation appeared in six searches; "not found" rather than "operating".

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: MON order 10.08.2020 No. 1031 'on the results of an unscheduled inspection' of this private HEI exists (per MON document snippet); its findings and any licence sanction are unknown — must be read before any publication.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Wikipedia claims the UK General Medical Council placed the university on a list of institutions whose qualifications it considers unacceptable and advised UK-bound students to avoid it; NOT confirmed on gmc-uk.org from search results (only the generic 'Is my qualification acceptable' page surfaced). Destination-country recognition risk for UK applicants.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Domain unsettled: Wikipedia infobox gives oimu.edu.ua; the search engine's summary separately referenced 'en.oimu.com.ua' as the OIMU site (referenced but not retrieved). Neither host was opened; the inventory flag 'domain unsettled' stands.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion: most search hits for either name resolve to the state Odesa National Medical University (ONMedU, listed slug odesa-national-medical-university) — including ONMedU's 2018-2019 rector/building conflict news; these must not be attributed to OIMU. A separate 'International Medical University (Not Accredited)' entry on iaar.agency (Kazakh accreditation agency) is very likely a different institution and must not be conflated.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Wikipedia programme list (veterinary medicine, biomedical engineering, MD/MBBS, $3,900 fee, 2020 enrolment) looks dated and partly implausible against the 2020 MON licence list (Medicine and Dentistry only); do not reuse these figures.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Only third-party recruitment listings (Brive) support English-medium teaching and fees; no official or government lead for language of instruction.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No EDEBO, Study in Ukraine or NAQA listing found in six searches; no accreditation lead for any programme (licence ≠ accreditation).

Missing evidence: Official website not opened (network policy): domain (oimu.edu.ua vs en.oimu.com.ua), official Ukrainian/English names, founding year, programme list and levels, language of instruction, fees, admissions page, application link, international office page.
Missing evidence: EDEBO registry record: legal name, ЄДРПОУ code, licence scope and current status, licensed volumes for 222 Medicine / 221 Dentistry / 226 Pharmacy / 223 Nursing.
Missing evidence: Text and outcome of MON order 10.08.2020 No. 1031 (unscheduled inspection) and any later MON licensing decisions 2021-2026 (including the Oct 2021 annex 227-dodatki.pdf).
Missing evidence: NAQA accreditation decisions for any programme (none found).
Missing evidence: Study in Ukraine (USCIE) portal listing and foreign-applicant admission procedure (none found).
Missing evidence: GMC position: confirmation or refutation of the 'unacceptable qualification' claim on gmc-uk.org.
Missing evidence: Operating status since February 2022 (any suspension, relocation or merger) — no lead either way.
Missing evidence: Whether pharmacy and nursing programmes exist and are licensed (only Brive/Wikipedia mention them).
Missing evidence: Any English-medium teaching confirmed by an official or government source (only third-party listings found).

Skeptic's note: Weakest case in the batch: existence rests on 2020-2021 MON licensing documents plus Wikipedia/Brive; no EDEBO card, Study in Ukraine or NAQA listing found and no activity lead of any kind since Oct 2021 (operating status unknown, not contradicted).

Skeptic's note: Open licence question (not a bar, but must be read before any fact is published): MON order 10.08.2020 No. 1031 'on the results of an unscheduled inspection' of this private HEI; and the Oct 2021 MON annex (pravo-diyalnosti/2021/october/227-dodatki.pdf) returned for its name with content unconfirmed. If that annex records licence annulment, the name-only listing should be withdrawn.
